=== comments, numbers and character constants
# a comment line
	.cseg	text
	mov	10, r10		; decimal
	mov	0xA, r11
	mov	012, r12	; a leading zero is octal
	mov	0b1010, r13
	.db	'A', '\n', "a\tb"
	.align	2
--- gnu
	.text
	mov	10, r10
	mov	10, r11
	mov	10, r12
	mov	10, r13
	.byte	0x41, 10, 0x61, 9, 0x62
	.balign	2
=== operator precedence: `&` binds tighter than `+`, and `!` is NOT
	.db	2 & 1 + 1, 1 + 2 << 1, !0x3, 6 | 1 ^ 3
	.dw	0x800001AF >> 5, 0x3BF >> 2 << 2
--- gnu
	.byte	1, 5, 0xfc, 4
	.long	0xfc00000d, 0x3bc
=== separators, the manual's examples
	movea	HIGHW(0x12345678), r0, r10
	movea	LOWW(0x12345678), r0, r10
	movhi	HIGHW1(0x12348765), r0, r10
	mov	HIGH(0xC08), r10
	mov	LOW(0xC08), r10
--- gnu
	movea	0x1234, r0, r10
	movea	0x5678, r0, r10
	movhi	0x1235, r0, r10
	mov	0xc, r10
	mov	8, r10
=== data directives, and CC-RH keeping the low bytes
	.db	0xA, 0xB, 0x1FF
	.db2	0x1234
	.dhw	0x5678
	.dshw	0x100
	.db4	0x12345678
	.dw	0x9ABCDEF0
	.db8	0x1122334455667788
	.ddw	1
	.ds	3
--- gnu
	.byte	0x0a, 0x0b, 0xff
	.short	0x1234, 0x5678, 0x80
	.long	0x12345678, 0x9abcdef0
	.long	0x55667788, 0x11223344
	.long	1, 0
	.space	3
=== .align takes a fill byte
	.db	1
	.align	4, 0xff
	.db	2
--- gnu
	.byte	1
	.balign	4, 0xff
	.byte	2
=== .set can be redefined, and each use sees its value then
TEN	.set	0x10
	mov	TEN - 0x05, r10
TEN	.set	TEN + 1
	mov	TEN, r10
--- gnu
	mov	0x0b, r10
	movea	0x11, r0, r10
=== mov chooses its form from the value
	mov	15, r10
	mov	-16, r10
	mov	16, r10
	mov	-32768, r10
	mov	0x10000, r10
	mov	0x12345, r10
	mov	-1, r10
	mov	0xFFFFFFFF, r10
	mov	5, r0
	mov32	0x10000, r10
	mov	r11, r10
--- gnu
	mov	15, r10
	mov	-16, r10
	movea	16, r0, r10
	movea	-32768, r0, r10
	movhi	1, r0, r10
	mov	0x12345, r10
	mov	-1, r10
	mov	-1, r10
	mov	5, r0
	mov	0x10000, r10
	mov	r11, r10
=== movea widens to movhi and a movea through r1
	movea	0x7FFF, r11, r10
	movea	0x20000, r11, r10
	movea	0x12348765, r11, r10
	movea	0x12340001, r11, r10
--- gnu
	movea	0x7fff, r11, r10
	movhi	2, r11, r10
	movhi	0x1235, r11, r1
	movea	-0x789b, r1, r10
	movhi	0x1234, r11, r1
	movea	1, r1, r10
=== add and mulh
	add	15, r10
	add	100, r10
	add	-32768, r10
	add	0x30000, r10
	add	0x12345, r10
	add	r11, r10
	mulh	7, r10
	mulh	1000, r10
	mulh	0x40000, r10
	mulh	0x40001, r10
--- gnu
	add	15, r10
	addi	100, r10, r10
	addi	-32768, r10, r10
	movhi	3, r0, r1
	add	r1, r10
	mov	0x12345, r1
	add	r1, r10
	add	r11, r10
	mulh	7, r10
	mulhi	1000, r10, r10
	movhi	4, r0, r1
	mulh	r1, r10
	mov	0x40001, r1
	mulh	r1, r10
=== addi and mulhi, into r0, the source, or another register
	addi	100, r11, r10
	addi	0x50000, r11, r0
	addi	0x50000, r11, r11
	addi	0x50000, r11, r10
	addi	0x50001, r11, r0
	addi	0x50001, r11, r11
	addi	0x50001, r11, r10
	mulhi	0x60000, r11, r11
	mulhi	0x60001, r11, r10
--- gnu
	addi	100, r11, r10
	movhi	5, r0, r1
	add	r11, r1
	movhi	5, r0, r1
	add	r1, r11
	movhi	5, r0, r10
	add	r11, r10
	mov	0x50001, r1
	add	r11, r1
	mov	0x50001, r1
	add	r1, r11
	mov	0x50001, r10
	add	r11, r10
	movhi	6, r0, r1
	mulh	r1, r11
	mov	0x60001, r10
	mulh	r11, r10
=== cmp and satadd go through r1
	cmp	-16, r10
	cmp	100, r10
	cmp	0x70000, r10
	cmp	0x70001, r10
	satadd	3, r10
	satadd	-300, r10
	satadd	0x7FFFFFFF, r10
--- gnu
	cmp	-16, r10
	movea	100, r0, r1
	cmp	r1, r10
	movhi	7, r0, r1
	cmp	r1, r10
	mov	0x70001, r1
	cmp	r1, r10
	satadd	3, r10
	movea	-300, r0, r1
	satadd	r1, r10
	mov	0x7fffffff, r1
	satadd	r1, r10
=== mul and mulu
	mul	255, r10, r11
	mul	-256, r10, r11
	mul	1000, r10, r11
	mul	0x80000, r10, r11
	mulu	511, r10, r11
	mulu	-1, r10, r11
	mulu	600, r10, r11
	mulu	0x80001, r10, r11
--- gnu
	mul	255, r10, r11
	mul	-256, r10, r11
	movea	1000, r0, r1
	mul	r1, r10, r11
	movhi	8, r0, r1
	mul	r1, r10, r11
	mulu	511, r10, r11
	mov	-1, r1
	mulu	r1, r10, r11
	movea	600, r0, r1
	mulu	r1, r10, r11
	mov	0x80001, r1
	mulu	r1, r10, r11
=== divh with two operands, and the three-operand divisions
	divh	5, r10
	divh	500, r10
	divh	0x90000, r10
	divh	0, r10, r11
	divh	-3, r10, r11
	div	1000, r10, r11
	divhu	0x90001, r10, r11
	divu	7, r10, r11
	div	r12, r10, r11
--- gnu
	mov	5, r1
	divh	r1, r10
	movea	500, r0, r1
	divh	r1, r10
	movhi	9, r0, r1
	divh	r1, r10
	divh	r0, r10, r11
	mov	-3, r1
	divh	r1, r10, r11
	movea	1000, r0, r1
	div	r1, r10, r11
	mov	0x90001, r1
	divhu	r1, r10, r11
	mov	7, r1
	divu	r1, r10, r11
	div	r12, r10, r11
=== satsub and satsubi
	satsub	0, r10
	satsub	100, r10
	satsub	0xA0000, r10
	satsub	0xA0001, r10
	satsubi	100, r11, r10
	satsubi	0xB0000, r11, r11
	satsubi	0xB0000, r11, r10
	satsubi	0xB0001, r11, r11
	satsubi	0xB0001, r11, r10
--- gnu
	satsub	r0, r10
	satsubi	100, r10, r10
	movhi	0xa, r0, r1
	satsub	r1, r10
	mov	0xa0001, r1
	satsub	r1, r10
	satsubi	100, r11, r10
	movhi	0xb, r0, r1
	satsub	r1, r11
	movhi	0xb, r0, r10
	satsubr	r11, r10
	mov	0xb0001, r1
	satsub	r1, r11
	mov	0xb0001, r10
	satsubr	r11, r10
=== and, or and xor with an immediate
	and	0, r10
	and	0xFFFF, r10
	and	-1, r10
	and	-100, r10
	and	0xC0000, r10
	or	0x10001, r10
	xor	0x8000, r10
--- gnu
	and	r0, r10
	andi	0xffff, r10, r10
	mov	-1, r1
	and	r1, r10
	movea	-100, r0, r1
	and	r1, r10
	movhi	0xc, r0, r1
	and	r1, r10
	mov	0x10001, r1
	or	r1, r10
	xori	0x8000, r10, r10
=== andi, ori and xori with values they cannot hold
	andi	0x1234, r11, r10
	andi	-1, r11, r0
	andi	-1, r11, r11
	andi	-1, r11, r10
	ori	-100, r11, r10
	xori	0xD0000, r11, r11
	ori	0xD0001, r11, r10
--- gnu
	andi	0x1234, r11, r10
	mov	-1, r1
	and	r11, r1
	mov	-1, r1
	and	r1, r11
	mov	-1, r10
	and	r11, r10
	movea	-100, r0, r10
	or	r11, r10
	movhi	0xd, r0, r1
	xor	r1, r11
	mov	0xd0001, r10
	or	r11, r10
=== not, satsubr, sub, subr and tst with an immediate
	not	0, r10
	not	5, r10
	sub	100, r10
	subr	0xE0000, r10
	tst	0xE0001, r10
	satsubr	-7, r10
--- gnu
	not	r0, r10
	mov	5, r1
	not	r1, r10
	movea	100, r0, r1
	sub	r1, r10
	movhi	0xe, r0, r1
	subr	r1, r10
	mov	0xe0001, r1
	tst	r1, r10
	mov	-7, r1
	satsubr	r1, r10
=== condition-suffixed setf, sasf, adf, sbf and cmov
	setfgt	r10
	setfnz	r10
	setfsa	r10
	sasfz	r10
	adfc	r10, r11, r12
	sbfnv	r10, r11, r12
	cmovlt	r10, r11, r12
	cmovz	5, r11, r12
	cmovz	100, r11, r12
	cmov	0x2, 0xF0000, r11, r12
--- gnu
	setf	0xf, r10
	setf	0xa, r10
	setf	0xd, r10
	sasf	0x2, r10
	adf	0x1, r10, r11, r12
	sbf	0x8, r10, r11, r12
	cmov	0x6, r10, r11, r12
	cmov	0x2, 5, r11, r12
	movea	100, r0, r1
	cmov	0x2, r1, r11, r12
	movhi	0xf, r0, r1
	cmov	0x2, r1, r11, r12
=== condition-suffixed cmpf
	cmpfeq.s	r10, r11, 0
	cmpfngt.d	r10, r12, 3
--- gnu
	cmpf.s	0x2, r10, r11, 0
	cmpf.d	0xf, r10, r12, 3
=== loads and stores choose 16 or 23 bits, then go through r1
	ld.w	4[sp], r10
	ld.w	[r11], r10
	ld.b	0x18000[r11], r12
	ld.w	0x18000[r11], r12
	ld.hu	-0x400000[r11], r12
	ld.w	0x12348000[r11], r12
	st.b	r12, 0x7FFF[r11]
	st.w	r12, 0x200000[r11]
	st.h	r12, 0x1000000[r11]
	ld23.w	0x10000[r11], r12
	st23.b	r12, -0x9000[r11]
	ld.bu	100, r12
--- gnu
	ld.w	4[sp], r10
	ld.w	0[r11], r10
	ld.b	0x18000[r11], r12
	ld.w	0x18000[r11], r12
	ld.hu	-0x400000[r11], r12
	movhi	0x1235, r11, r1
	ld.w	-0x8000[r1], r12
	st.b	r12, 0x7fff[r11]
	st.w	r12, 0x200000[r11]
	movhi	0x100, r11, r1
	st.h	r12, 0[r1]
	ld.w	0x10000[r11], r12
	st.b	r12, -0x9000[r11]
	ld.bu	100[r0], r12
=== bit instructions, with the displacement and register left out
	set1	3, 4[r10]
	clr1	0, [r10]
	not1	7, 0x100
	tst1	5, 0x9000[r10]
	set1	r11, [r10]
--- gnu
	set1	3, 4[r10]
	clr1	0, 0[r10]
	not1	7, 0x100[r0]
	movhi	1, r10, r1
	tst1	5, -0x7000[r1]
	set1	r11, [r10]
=== sld and sst without [ep]
	sld.b	4, r10
	sst.w	r10, 8
	sld.h	6[ep], r10
--- gnu
	sld.b	4[ep], r10
	sst.w	r10, 8[ep]
	sld.h	6[ep], r10
=== push, pushm, pop and popm
	push	r10
	pop	r10
	pushm	r10, r11, r12
	popm	r10, r11, r12
--- gnu
	add	-4, sp
	st.w	r10, 0[sp]
	ld.w	0[sp], r10
	add	4, sp
	addi	-12, sp, sp
	st.w	r12, 8[sp]
	st.w	r11, 4[sp]
	st.w	r10, 0[sp]
	ld.w	0[sp], r10
	ld.w	4[sp], r11
	ld.w	8[sp], r12
	addi	12, sp, sp
=== prepare and dispose with a plain register list, sizes in bytes
	prepare	r26, r29, r31, 0x10
	prepare	0x103, 0x10
	prepare	r20, r21, 4, sp
	prepare	r20, 0, 0x1234
	dispose	0x10, r26, r29, r31
	dispose	8, r20, r21, [lp]
--- gnu
	prepare	{r26, r29, r31}, 4
	prepare	{r26, r29, r31}, 4
	prepare	{r20, r21}, 1, sp
	prepare	{r20}, 0, 0x1234
	dispose	4, {r26, r29, r31}
	dispose	2, {r20, r21}, [lp]
=== prepare and dispose with frames too big for the instruction
	prepare	r20, 0x200
	prepare	r20, 0x10000
	dispose	0x200, r20
	dispose	0x10000, r20, [lp]
--- gnu
	prepare	{r20}, 0
	movea	-0x200, sp, sp
	prepare	{r20}, 0
	mov	0x10000, r1
	sub	r1, sp
	movea	0x200, sp, sp
	dispose	0, {r20}
	mov	0x10000, r1
	add	r1, sp
	dispose	0, {r20}, [lp]
=== pushsp and popsp take two operands
	pushsp	r20, r25
	popsp	r20, r25
--- gnu
	pushsp	r20-r25
	popsp	r20-r25
=== branches to labels relax as in GNU as, and jcond is bcond
	.cseg	text
start:	bz	start
	jnz	start
	jbr	start
	bsa	start
	br	start
	jr	start
	jarl	start, lp
	jmp	[r10]
--- gnu
	.text
start:	bz	start
	bnz	start
	br	start
	bsa	start
	br	start
	jr	start
	jarl	start, lp
	jmp	[r10]
=== a numeric branch displacement that fits 9 bits
	bz	0x10
	bnz9	-8
	jr	0x100
	jr32	0x400000
	jmp	0x12345678
--- gnu
	bz	0x10
	bnz	-8
	jr	0x100
	jr	0x400000
	jmp	0x12345678[r0]
=== a numeric branch displacement that needs 17 bits
	bz	0x1000
	.ds	0x1000 - 4
--- gnu
	bz	L1
	.space	0x1000 - 4
L1:
=== a numeric branch displacement that needs 22 bits
	bz	0x10004
	br	0x10004
	bsa	0x10008
	.ds	0x10000
--- gnu
	bz	L1
	br	L1b
	bsa	L2
	.space	0x10004 - 18
L1:	.space	6
L1b:	.space	8
L2:
=== symbols may contain @ and $
a@b	.set	3
c$d	.set	4
	mov	a@b, r10
	mov	c$d, r11
--- gnu
	mov	3, r10
	mov	4, r11
=== conditional assembly
SW	.set	0
$IFDEF SW
$IFN SW
	mov	1, r10
$ELSE
	mov	2, r10
$ENDIF
$ENDIF
$IFNDEF NOPE
	mov	3, r10
$ENDIF
--- gnu
	mov	1, r10
	mov	3, r10
=== macros: named parameters, `~` concatenation, .local
PUSHMAC	.macro	REG
	add	-4, sp
	st.w	REG, 0x0[sp]
	.endm
abc	.macro	x
abc~x:	mov	r10, r20
	.endm
m1	.macro	x
	.local	a
a:	.dw	a - a + x
	.endm
	PUSHMAC	r19
	abc	STU
	m1	10
	m1	20
--- gnu
	add	-4, sp
	st.w	r19, 0[sp]
abcSTU:	mov	r10, r20
	.long	10
	.long	20
=== .rept and .irp end with .endm
	.rept	3
	nop
	.endm
	.irp	PARA 1, 2, 3
	add	PARA, r10
	.endm
--- gnu
	nop
	nop
	nop
	add	1, r10
	add	2, r10
	add	3, r10
=== the manual's own expression examples
FIVE	.set	+5
NO	.set	-1
	mov	256 / 50, r10
	mov	256 % 50, r10
	mov	!0x3, r10
	mov	0x6FA & 0xF, r10
	mov	0xA | 0b1101, r10
	mov	0x9A ^ 0x9D, r12
	mov	0x21 << 2, r20
	mov	(4 + 3) * 2, r10
	mov	FIVE, r10
	mov	NO, r10
--- gnu
	mov	5, r10
	mov	6, r10
	mov	-4, r10
	mov	0xa, r10
	mov	0xf, r10
	mov	7, r12
	movea	0x84, r0, r20
	mov	14, r10
	mov	5, r10
	mov	-1, r10
=== label references: `#label`, `!label` and the separators of a label
	.extern	ext
	mov	#ext, r10
	movea	#ext, r11, r10
	movea	!ext, r0, r10
	movhi	HIGHW1(#ext), r0, r10
	movea	LOWW(#ext), r10, r10
	movhi	HIGHW(ext), r0, r10
	add	#ext, r10
	addi	!ext, r10, r11
	cmp	#ext, r10
	ld.w	#ext[r11], r12
	st.w	r12, LOWW(#ext)[r1]
	set1	3, #ext[r10]
	.dw	#ext, !ext
--- gnu
	mov	hilo(ext), r10
	movhi	hi(ext), r11, r1
	movea	lo(ext), r1, r10
	movea	zdaoff(ext), r0, r10
	movhi	hi(ext), r0, r10
	movea	lo(ext), r10, r10
	movhi	hi0(ext), r0, r10
	mov	hilo(ext), r1
	add	r1, r10
	addi	zdaoff(ext), r10, r11
	mov	hilo(ext), r1
	cmp	r1, r10
	movhi	hi(ext), r11, r1
	ld.w	lo(ext)[r1], r12
	st.w	r12, lo(ext)[r1]
	movhi	hi(ext), r10, r1
	set1	3, lo(ext)[r1]
	.long	ext, ext
